verdict.rationale: Navan ships its own AI assistants (Ava, Navan Edge), so asking whether they can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence shows Navan only in the MCP server role: a hosted Navan MCP that Claude, Cursor and others connect to. That server-side capability does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing documents Navan plugging in third-party MCP servers.
